The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Corrects the placement: selectors raise DoesNotExist and the API catches it and returns the standard 404 body (detail: Not found)
- Keeps the error contract consistent across endpoints rather than adding a new shape
